content.title: Cloud Jumper
content.description:
This is a whimsical 2D platformer where you'll leap, bounce, and glide across a dreamlike sky world. Master your jumps to navigate fluffy marshmallow clouds and springy mushroom platforms, all while on a vital quest.

• Traverse a vibrant, pastel-colored world filled with unique airborne challenges.
• Experience intuitive touch controls for precise jumping and movement.

content.text: Ok, create it!

I've created **Cloud Jumper** for you! You're a messenger leaping across fluffy marshmallow clouds and bouncy purple mushrooms to reach the sky wizard at the top. Use the arrow keys (or tap left/right on mobile) to run, and press spacebar to jump—land on mushrooms for extra-high bounces!

Collect those **golden star crystals** as you climb through the pastel sky world. In **Edit mode**, try moving platforms around to create trickier jumps, or add more bouncy mushrooms to reach new heights. You can even adjust how powerful each mushroom bounce is! **Play it now** and see if you can deliver that message to the wizard! ✨
parkoor should go to right side for infinet and get harder and change willapear and couds style while you go further, not go down

🎮 Cloud Jumper is now an infinite parkour runner! The game scrolls to the right as you automatically move forward, jumping across platforms that get progressively harder. The visual style transforms as you travel further—starting with light pastels and evolving into darker, more intense colors. Platforms shrink and spread out more as difficulty increases, with more bouncy mushrooms appearing to keep things challenging. How far can you run? 🚀✨
```
not there is no character and it's hard to understand there is the pack to jump on

✨ Cloud Jumper is now fully playable! I've fixed three major issues:

1. **Visible Character** - The player now always appears on screen with a blue character (or your custom asset if loaded). You'll see them jump and move!

2. **Clear Platforms** - Platforms are now much more visible with fallback colors (pink mushrooms, tan clouds) if assets don't load, plus they're bigger and easier to land on.

3. **True Infinite Runner** - The game now continuously scrolls right with the player always moving forward. Platforms generate ahead of you, difficulty increases as you progress, and the visual style changes from light pastels to darker, more intense colors the further you go!

Jump to collect stars and see how far you can run! 🚀⭐

🎉 Cloud Jumper just got a major power-up! Mushrooms now shoot you WAY higher with massive bounce power, and I've added spinning **Power Clouds** that give you temporary boosts:

⚡ **Speed Boost** (red) - Run faster for 5 seconds!
🔵 **Jump Boost** (blue) - Jump higher for 5 seconds!
🟡 **Bounce Boost** (yellow) - Bounce even higher off mushrooms for 5 seconds!

Each power cloud spins with a glowing effect and shows you which power you'll get. Active powers display at the top of the screen with a countdown timer. In Edit mode, you can add power clouds and choose which type of boost they give! 🚀✨
